opening.argument: The title presents Forsage as an earning platform and emphasizes income, while the description invites viewers seeking online work to follow and contact the promoter about joining it. The dashboard then shows a personal Forsage link, 25 BUSD in profits, four partners, four team members, level-one receipt notifications, and a new partner joining the team. Its “Join Priority Leaders” feature further ties participation and earnings to recruitment and maintaining a tiered structure.
